channel.title: Homes Under the Hammer
channel.desc: Dion is worried about the water pouring into a house in Newcastle-under-Lyme. Martin visits a two-bed semi-detached in Stafford, in the West Midlands, bought by a couple of renovation rookies. He's also in Worthing, in West Sussex, to see an interesting mixed commercial and residential lot.
